limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The motivating preprint arXiv:2609.20460v1 was submitted on 17 September 2026, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains a residual risk. The theorem gives universal lower bounds rather than a full asymptotic for general orthogonal representations, does not address q<1/2, and supplies no matching upper bound. Classical compact-group representation theory is used as input and is not claimed as new. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
provenance: Representation-theoretic analysis of orthogonal compact-group automorphic random multiplicative functions, using the invariant quadratic tensor and the compact-group framework of Leung, arXiv:2609.20460v1.
record_title: Universal square-class correlations in orthogonal compact-group random multiplicative functions
